notes.title: Full Release v1.6.0
notes.notes:
v1.6.0

Features:

 New Maps: World 1 and Shinjuku
 Chat text size setting
 Separate voice chat room for dead players
 Random name colours in chat for visual clarity
 Main maps and Workshop maps have been separated with tabs
 Added discord rich presence
 Can now play custom maps in solo matches against bots (Experimental)

Fixes:

 Transition effect will no longer act silly during Laser Tag matches.

notes.title: Full Release v1.5.1

notes.title: Full Release v1.5.0
notes.notes:
Features
-New Maps: Dojo, and Toxic Lab.
-New Map Builder feature, users can add powerups, jump pads, and jump ramps.
-New limited cosmetic: 1 Year Anniversary.
-Dojo has acquired 2 of Temples tracks, partially due to Temple having 5 previously.
-New track for Skylines.
-New transition overlay that plays in several places, most notably loading screens.
-Camera now bobs up and down when you dance.
-Minor adjustments to Moon, Last Stop, and Skylines.
-Increased scroll sensitivity on scrollable menus.

Fixes
-Bomb beeping sound no longer plays after death/game end.
-Fixed that one material in the tutorial being way too bright.
-Added back the missing chain mesh on Colosseum.
-Bomb icon now disappears on death/game end.
-Player level up should now function correctly on the in-game EXP meter.
-Optimised the files a bit so the game should be slightly smaller.

Known Bugs/Issues
-Proximity chat still has issues after a player dies.
-Bomb beeping still sometimes falls out of sync.
-New Map Manager features have not been extensively tested, you may encounter issues; if you see any, please help us out by reporting them so we can have them fixed by next update!

notes.title: Full Release v1.4.3

-Added input device option instead of just defaulting to one device.
-Added option to switch between Open Microphone and Push To Talk for input.
-Bomb on IT player now blinks and beeps instead of gradually turning red.
-Removed SFX on some sliders.
-Added dance mechanic.
-Invisible walls like above Temples gate walls have been replaced with a shader that appears when you get very close.
-Improved splash screen.
-Optimized some player code for smoother performance.
-Reverted temporary Christmas look on main menu and all maps.

Fixes
-Removed expired cosmetics from the in-game store.

notes.title: Full Release 1.0.0
notes.notes:
New things to look forward to:

New Map: 
Colosseum - Our smallest map yet! Drop in for the most intense games of Extreme Tag to date!


Levelling System & Free Hats
New Features - Everyone loves playing Tag but now you can level up and grind for rewards! Every 5 levels you will spin a roulette of hats and get one for free! Grind your way to in online matches, private matches or even against bots to gain EXP! 


Map Adjustments:
Shroomville - Shroomville is one of our biggest maps so we want players to be able to move around the map freely. More mobility options and adjusted platforms have been added!

Moon - Moon needed a little bit of a touch up visually, you may notice a new AI skybox and some new props

Last Stop - We added a train derail to Last Stop which players have LOVED! Now we randomised the derails with the red and green trains for extra fun!


Visual Indicators:
When sprinting, players will now have white speed-lines over their HUD! Using powerups, dashing and using different mobility pads around the map will also give different coloured indicators!


Audio:
More audio has been added to: the menu, powerups, and much more!


Menu:
Huge menu update! Find a cleaner, more sleek menu with updated map thumbnails and more!


And much more!

notes.title: Early Access v1.1 Update
notes.notes:
Early Access V1.1



Features:

- Added a new Temple map

- Added a push mechanic that lets you push away nearby players in game

- Added a map importer that lets you import your own custom maps and upload them to the Steam Workshop and play them online with other people

- Replaced the colour wheel in the loadout menu with eight different colours to choose from

- Added new music tracks to all maps



Fixes:

- Loadout menu options now highlighted so that you know which one is currently selected

- Fixed issue where the default map in the host menu was set to an old cut map

- Possibly fixed the issue where cosmetics for some people are floating

- Possibly fixed an issue where if the hiders win in a hide and seek game, it'll sometimes say the seekers won



Known issues:

- If you join a lobby that is hosting a custom workshop map and you don't have the map downloaded, your game may crash or play without a map
